description:
A number's inbox, newest activity first. Poll it with `updated_since`
for changes since your last call, or page it with `cursor`. There are no
event webhooks, so polling is how an integration learns about new
messages.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

filter.description: `needs_person` is a person-owned or paused conversation. `window_closed` is one you can only reach with a template.

number_id.description:
Id of a WhatsApp number in your workspace, from
[listWhatsappNumbers](/docs/api-reference/whatsapp/listWhatsappNumbers).
A number in another workspace answers `404`.

q.description: Search the customer's name, phone number and message text.

updated_since.description:
An ISO 8601 date and time, such as `2026-10-01T09:00:00+00:00`. Returns
conversations with a change at or after it. No offset means UTC.

name: listWhatsappConversations
